SparkR / SPARKR-178
Create a R runner to integrate with Spark Submit
Issue Type: New Feature
Assignee: Unassigned
Components: Deployment
Created: 21/Jan/15 5:28 PM
Priority: Critical
Reporter: Shivaram Venkataraman

In light of SPARKR-177 we should create a new Java class that read config variables, system properties from Spark Submit and fork the R process based on that. This will be similar to PythonRunner at https://github.com/apache/spark/blob/master/core/src/main/scala/org/apache/spark/deploy/PythonRunner.scala .

This should also also solve SPARKR-116

Re: Create a R runner to integrate with Spark Submit

Felix Cheung Thanks for your interest. The WIP branch I have is at https://github.com/shivaram/sparkr-pkg/tree/sparkr-runner – I have so far tested this locally with a Standalone Spark master and with a local YARN cluster (in a Cloudera VM).

I'd like to test this in a multi-machine YARN cluster and it would be great if you could help with that. Let me know if you want to try it and I can give some build / test instructions if necessary.

The other main piece which is missing is that the SparkR doesn't use the SparkConf created by parsing command line arguments. This is related to https://sparkr.atlassian.net/browse/SPARKR-141 and what we need to do here is to create a wrapper around SparkConf (something like https://github.com/apache/spark/blob/master/python/pyspark/conf.py). I was going to try and do this over the next couple of days, but let me know if you want to have a shot at it !

Re: Create a R runner to integrate with Spark Submit

Felix Cheung The best way to try this would be be to clone my github branch and build from source (instead of using install_github). This is mainly because I haven't packaged the `sparkR-submit` script as a part of the installed package. So the instructions to install this would be something like

git clone https://github.com/shivaram/SparkR-pkg.git -b sparkr-runner SparkR-pkg-runner-test
cd SparkR-pkg-runner-test
USE_YARN=1 SPARK_YARN_VERSION=2.4.0 SPARK_HADOOP_VERSION=2.4.0 R CMD INSTALL pkg/

You will then need to repeat this on all the nodes or copy out the installed lib directory to all the nodes in the cluster – Longer term we probably try to send a tar/gz via YARN and automatically install it on the worker nodes, but I haven't figured that out yet.

Following that you can try out something like 

export SPARK_HOME=<your_spark_install_dir>
export /YARN_CONF_DIR=<dir_where_yarn_configs_are>
./sparkR-submit --master yarn-client ./examples/pi.R yarn-client 4

Let me know if something needs more clarification.

And you are right – the last part about SparkConf is SPARKR-141

Re: Create a R runner to integrate with Spark Submit

I've tested this against CDH 5.3 cluster in YARN mode.

I installed from my branch as such:
```
USE_YARN=1 SPARK_VERSION=1.1.0 SPARK_YARN_VERSION=2.5.0-cdh5.3.0 SPARK_HADOOP_VERSION=2.5.0-cdh5.3.0 R
```
```R
library(devtools)
install_github("felixcheung/SparkR-pkg", ref="working", subdir="pkg")
```

And then ran sparkR-submit as such:
```
export YARN_CONF_DIR=/etc/hadoop/conf
export SPARK_HOME=/opt/cloudera/parcels/CDH-5.3.0-1.cdh5.3.0.p0.30/lib/spark
export JAVA_HOME=/usr/java/jdk1.7.0_67-cloudera
/usr/lib64/R/library/SparkR/sparkR-submit --master yarn-client ./pi.R yarn-client 4
```

I made 2 small changes to make this work:
https://github.com/felixcheung/SparkR-pkg/commit/e3079e4b562ac3a91aa6c76ec098b70c3934578d
https://github.com/felixcheung/SparkR-pkg/commit/614da5d9b0f6e19b7d8476506117ffcd6e7685aa

I tried creating a pull request but it seemed your sparkr-runner branch had not been merge to master yet.
